svg.text: ENTERPRISE MANUFACTURING VISUAL QUALITY INSPECTION: <15MS EDGE ANOMALY + VLM
8.5ms Edge PatchCore/YOLOv11 + 4.5% Gray-Zone 7B VLM Hits 0.06% Escape & 0.8% Over-Kill
120 Lines / 12 FPS (50ms PLC Gate): Tier 1 Cloud VLM (850ms Misses Conveyor, $690K/mo) vs. Tier 2 AOI vs. Tier 4 ($72K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Missed Reject Gates & 28.5% Over-Kill
1. Cloud VLM Streaming Misses 50ms PLC Gate (850ms Latency):
• By the time a cloud VLM returns after 850ms, the defective EV
battery cell has already passed the pneumatic reject valve by 4m!
2. Rule-Based Pixel AOI Suffers 28.5% Over-Kill False Rejects:
• Harmless water droplets, lighting glare & metal grain trigger
pseudo-defects requiring 45 manual human re-inspectors
3. Closed-Set YOLO Misses Unseen Zero-Day Defects (6.4% Escape):
• Supervised boxes fail on foreign fibers or novel solder bridges
Production Failure Impact (120 Lines / 31M Parts/Mo):
• Inline Latency (Tier 1): 850ms (17x slower than 50ms PLC gate)
• Over-Kill False Rejects (Tier 2): 28.5% | Escape (Tier 3): 6.4%
• Monthly Re-Inspection, Scrap & Cloud TCO: $690,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 8.5ms Edge PatchCore/YOLO + Gray-Zone VLM
1. Line-Side Jetson Orin TensorRT YOLOv11 + PatchCore (8.5ms):
• Catches known defects + zero-day anomalies in 8.5ms (well inside
the 50ms PLC window) using only 200 golden `OK` training samples
2. 4.5% Gray-Zone Holding Buffer -> On-Prem 7B VLM (0.8% Over-Kill):
• Diverts borderline frames to a 3m buffer where `Qwen2.5-VL-7B`
separates harmless water/glare from true cracks in 420ms
3. Closed-Loop OPC-UA / MES SPC Drift Alarming (30m New SKU):
• Alerts MES when Nozzle #4 produces 3 consecutive solder bridges
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Inline PLC Trigger Latency: 8.5ms (100% within 50ms window)
• Defect Escape Rate: 0.06% | Over-Kill False Reject: 0.8%
• Monthly Total TCO: $72,000 / mo (-89.6% savings vs. Tier 1)
